title: JurisdictionDetermination
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 13.1. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.casework.JurisdictionDetermination). The recorded decision that a specific competent authority has jurisdiction over a specific case kind in a specific scope. Determinations are APPENDED, never rewritten: a challenge changes `status`, a transfer sets `valid_until` and `transferred_to_jurisdiction_id` while keeping the determination's own authority reference, so 'who was competent, and until when' stays answerable after any number of transfers (Framework 13.1, 'preserved jurisdiction history'). Only a determination in status asserted or confirmed, inside its validity window, permits a substantive decision. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
